research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator and GOV.UK primary guidance only; high-rise accountable-person, risk-assessment, safety-management and resident-engagement methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: Resident-engagement purpose
verified_claims: The strategy explains how residents and residential-unit owners are involved in and informed about building safety decisions.
limitations: Engagement is not a substitute for technical safety assessment.

sources.name: PAP resident-strategy duties
verified_claims: The PAP must prepare, follow, review and revise the strategy, keep review records, provide it to APs and consult when necessary.
limitations: Preparation of a strategy does not prove that engagement duties are being performed effectively.

sources.name: AP distribution and cooperation
verified_claims: Accountable persons must provide the latest strategy to residents in their parts and work with other accountable persons to update it.
limitations: Distribution cannot be assumed without delivery evidence.

sources.name: Strategy preparation trigger
verified_claims: The PAP should prepare the strategy as soon as possible when the building becomes occupied or they become the PAP.
limitations: The trigger date must be determined from building-specific occupancy and appointment evidence.

sources.name: Strategy submission with certificate application
verified_claims: The PAP must submit the strategy when BSR directs it to apply for a building assessment certificate.
limitations: Submission does not mean BSR has approved every part of the strategy.

sources.name: Building-specific resident strategy
verified_claims: A strategy should be specific to the building and reflect residents' needs and preferences.
limitations: A generic portfolio template is not sufficient evidence of building-specific engagement.

sources.name: Decision information to residents
verified_claims: The strategy should describe which decisions residents will be asked about and what information they will receive, including communication method and work timing.
limitations: Information provision does not transfer statutory decision responsibility to residents.

sources.name: Consultation on disruptive works
verified_claims: For work lasting more than one day that blocks part of the building or disrupts residents, the PAP must ask about timing and minimising disruption.
limitations: Consultation does not allow necessary safety work to be omitted.

sources.name: Emergency repair consultation exception
verified_claims: Residents do not need to be consulted before immediate emergency repairs needed to protect health, safety or welfare.
limitations: The exception applies to urgent protective repairs and should not be used for ordinary planned work.

sources.name: Resident communication methods
verified_claims: Engagement can use post, websites, email, social media, apps, meetings or visits.
limitations: Offering a channel does not prove it is accessible or effective for all residents.

sources.name: Accessible communications
verified_claims: The strategy should consider language and alternative formats such as large text, easy read, braille or audio.
limitations: A listed format must not be treated as delivered unless resident needs and actual provision are verified.

sources.name: Opinion, feedback and data handling
verified_claims: The strategy should explain how opinions are collected, reviewed and acted on, how feedback is provided, timescales and GDPR-compliant storage.
limitations: Collection of opinions does not require adoption of every suggestion.

sources.name: Participation measurement
verified_claims: Participation can be reviewed using response counts, surveys, focus groups, meetings and visits, with results recorded.
limitations: Response volume alone does not measure the quality or representativeness of engagement.

sources.name: Minimum consultation period
verified_claims: Consultation on the first strategy and changes must include residents and APs and last at least three weeks.
limitations: A three-week period does not by itself prove meaningful participation.

sources.name: Resident-strategy review triggers
verified_claims: The PAP must review the strategy at least every two years, after mandatory occurrence reports and after significant material alterations, and record every review.
limitations: A review record is not evidence that identified improvements were implemented.
